title: After School
description: Grandma is emotional because Kid-3 starts kindergarten tomorrow. Kid-3 reassures her that she’ll come home after school—and already has plans for how they can celebrate.
alt: In a cozy living room, Grandma kneels beside five-year-old Kid-3, who is wearing a purple backpack and holding her stuffed bunny. A teary-eyed Grandma says, 'I’m going to miss you when you start kindergarten tomorrow.' Kid-3 rests a reassuring hand on Grandma’s shoulder and replies, 'Don’t worry, Grandma. I’ll come home after school. Then you can take me for ice cream.'
